Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and mild renal impairment (elevated creatinine). There is monocytosis and basophilia, with mild transaminitis (elevated ALT). These findings may suggest a systemic process such as infection, inflammation, or bone marrow suppression. Clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
